property_summary: For any caller and any initial drugs>0, calling seedMarket on the correct contract sets initialized to true (and marketDrugs to the supplied amount) while the mutant that omits setting initialized can leave initialized false for some inputs; thus initialized==true after seedMarket is a universal property of the reference and is violated by the mutant for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the assignment to initialized so initialized remains unchanged by seedMarket.
